title: Human Platelet Isolation Protocol
author: Allen Bennett
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pymdpu6

steps.title: Collect blood in citrate
steps.instruction: Use an IV butterfly set to draw blood directly into sodium citrate Vacutainer tubes.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected blood at 1,200 rpm for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Harvest plasma
steps.instruction: Transfer the top plasma fraction to a new tube.

steps.title: Dilute plasma
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Tyrodes buffer to the plasma and mix.

steps.title: Add prostacyclin
steps.instruction: Add prostacyclin (PGI₂) to achieve a final concentration of 10 µM.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2,800 rpm for 5 minutes, decant the supernatant, and gently resuspend the platelet pellet in Tyrode's buffer.

substeps.instruction: Gently resuspend the platelet pellet in Tyrode's buffer.

steps.title: Prepare platelets
steps.instruction: Dilute the platelet suspension 1:20 in fresh Tyrode's buffer for downstream applications such as flow cytometry, or alternatively lyse the pellet directly for ELISA or western blotting.
